profile.catch: I gotta make my moms proud!  I'll become the top Umamusume in all of Japan!
profile.detail: Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

profile.catch: I just want to see... that scenery from the lead.
profile.detail: An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

profile.catch: Here begins the legend of the invincible Teio!
profile.detail: A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, Symboli Rudolf, and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

profile.catch: The track's like a dance floor, and I'm feelin' groovy today!
profile.detail: A dashing Umamusume with a sisterly demeanor and a retro way of speaking. She is a speed demon who adores the pure joy of the wind in her face. On the road, her hot rod is the one burning rubber, but in a race, it's her own two feet tearing up the track. Despite her tremendous power, she isn't pompous, and is well-liked by everyone.

profile.catch: Don't cry, my darling pony. If there's something on your mind, speak!
profile.detail: A dashing performer who never hesitates to take another runner gently by the hand. You won't catch her flirting, however. Instead, she helps her dear ponies in her capacity as leader of Ritto Dormitory. As a runner, she hopes to captivate audiences just like her mother, a stage actress. Her ultimate stage: the Triple Crown.

profile.catch: I'm going to win this for the folks back home... But first, sustenance.
profile.detail: Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works hard to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

profile.catch: So long as it's fun, right? Right?!
profile.detail: An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

profile.catch: I've just gotta be the coolest to ever do it!
profile.detail: Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter. Her grandstanding nature sees her charge daringly into any challenge, never afraid of what she might face. She has a bit of a cat-and-dog relationship with her roommate, Daiwa Scarlet.

profile.catch: Second-best won't cut it. Everything I do is for the sake of being number one!
profile.detail: Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

profile.catch: BANG! ☆ Who's ready for a round of sharpshootin'?!
profile.detail: A cowgirl with a heart as big as her might. As friendly as they come, she's one heck of a hug machine. She tends to get lonely, however, so perhaps that's why she's one heck of a party planner too! Specializing in sprints, her powerful dash has even caught the eye of her friend, Silence Suzuka.

profile.catch: Noble and gallant, I march on... towards my ambitions.
profile.detail: Though born in America, her parents' love of Japanese culture influenced her to also love all things to do with the country—to the point of being called the spitting image of the ideal Japanese beauty. She speaks in a friendly manner and is easy to get along with, but her will is firm. Her determination to win is second to none. She shares a room with her close friend, El Condor Pasa.

profile.catch: You and me, one-on-one! Hishiama's gonna show you some heat!
profile.detail: A hot-blooded racer who loves nothing more than a one-on-one fight. Though seen by most as a fierce competitor, she has the good grace to congratulate her opponents should they win. She is the rather hot-tempered leader of Miho Dormitory, and is proficient at cooking, cleaning, and laundry. Although generally reliable in just about any situation, you probably shouldn't mention the notion of ghosts or thunder around her.

profile.catch: I'll bring honor and glory to the Mejiro family!
profile.detail: Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

profile.catch: Soaring towards victory with the heart of a wrestler! El's the world's strooongest!
profile.detail: A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear. Her mask is a present from her pro wrestler father and she insists on keeping it on at all times—no matter what. Her best friend and roommate, Grass Wonder, constantly scolds her for being too reckless.

profile.catch: Haaah ha ha ha! I am the star of this play, and it shall be known the world over as a masterpiece!
profile.detail: An opera queen who's so self-absorbed, it's comical. Her mannernisms are over-the-top, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She truly believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She is admired by Meisho Doto.

profile.catch: I'll keep running until my thirst is quenched. Get out of my way, or get torn apart.
profile.detail: A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She herself has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is Biwa Hayahide's little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president.

profile.catch: Fortune smiles upon the brave. Let us create a world where all Umamusume can live in bliss.
profile.detail: Well-versed in both the ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body,  she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy. She seeks to be a model Umamusume, and as such, is keenly aware of the example that she sets. Her dream is to foster a new era in which all Umamusume can live in true happiness. She is especially admired by Tokai Teio.

profile.catch: Just as my esteemed mother once did, I must train to perfection and lead others along my path!
profile.detail: The vice president of Tracen Academy's student council, known to the other students as the "Empress." The daughter of an accomplished racer, she constantly strives to live up to her mother's racing prowess and ability to guide others. To this end, she has joined her friend and confidant, Symboli Rudolf, in the student council. Despite her strict schedule, she still makes time to tend the flowers in the garden.

profile.catch: Guehehe! ♪ Oh my precious, adorable Umas... I could just watch you all day! ☆
profile.detail: A veritable Umamusume otaku. She came to Tracen Academy to be close to all of her favorite runners. She does respect boundaries, however, and tries to stay out of trouble. She's eager to get up close and personal with as many Umamusume as possible, and to that end she has revealed surprising ability both on dirt and turf.

profile.catch: Hey now, why don't we take it easy? Tortoise and the hare and all that.
profile.detail: As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes. Her hobbies include taking afternoon naps and fishing. She also loves cats and is often seen curling up with them outside on the grass. She's classmates with Special Week.

profile.catch: Debt can't keep me down! I'm the White Lightning of Naniwa!
profile.detail: A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny Oguri Cap make for a good comedic duo.

profile.catch: Whether about racing or the culture itself, I must learn more about this lovely place! ♪
profile.detail: An exchange student from Ireland who is said to come from a well-to-do family that traces its lineage back to the royalty of another country. Perhaps due to a sheltered childhood, she's very curious about everything, which can lead to some sticky situations. She hopes to make a lot of memories while at the academy.

profile.catch: This... is how you derive victory!
profile.detail: A theorist through and through, she breaks down any problem systematically. Theory-driven as she is, she values practical application, so her methods never end up as just talk. She has honed her ability to compete with the overwhelming talent of her sister, Narita Brian. She is good friends with schoolmates Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket.

profile.catch: When inspiration strikes, Maya takes flight! Copy that! ☆
profile.detail: A rambunctious young genius of an Umamusume who seeks affection from everyone she meets. Having a pilot for a father, Mayano Top Gun often mixes aviation lingo into her speech. Her tendency to obsess over whatever new and exciting thing is in front of her betrays how far she is from becoming the mature, sophisticated lady of her dreams. However, she does possess incredible intuition and an almost supernatural sense of the right thing to do in any situation.

profile.catch: I'm... right here, with someone you can't see.
profile.detail: A mysterious girl who blends in with the shadows... and speaks with them. She can often be found sticking close to the walls, tracing odd patterns with her fingertips. According to her, however, she's always with her "friend." She enjoys sipping a nice cup of coffee, as gulping it down too quickly hurts her stomach.

profile.catch: Target acquired. Commencing Operation: Triple Crown.
profile.detail: An Umamusume also known as the "Cyborg." She views the world through the lens of programming and databases, carrying out her objectives in an expressionless and robotic manner. Even so, she is not an emotionless machine—her constant training since her youth has simply resulted in less interactions with people, leading to her current personality. Underneath that robotic shell, she does indeed have feelings.

profile.catch: No problems pecs can't solve! Let's get swole together!
profile.weight: A bit bulkier from muscle growth
profile.detail: A sporty girl who loves a good workout. Although born into the prestigious Mejiro family, her animated personality somewhat betrays that fact. She has something of an inferiority complex surrounding her childhood friend, Mejiro McQueen, and wishes to be as fast and pretty as her. Though physically strong, her heart is rather delicate.

profile.catch: Come now, eat up! I promise you it's very buono! ♪
profile.detail: A magnanimous chef who loves to feed others just as much as she loves to eat. She is a gentle soul who wishes to see the smiling faces of those around her. She was born abroad, and has come to be somewhat of a sumo fanatic, but ultimately decided upon a life on the track over one in the ring. It seems that her childhood dream was to become like a chanko hot pot.

profile.catch: I wanna run in the Twinkly Series and become a spiffy city girl!
profile.detail: A simple girl from the Iwate countryside, she would often lend a hand on the family farm. Her rural northern upbringing has made her a sincere Umamusume who doesn't back down from a challenge, yet despite her humble country background, her true desire is to be a cosmopolitan city girl and compete in the Twinkle Series. She sees Gold City as that very ideal.

profile.catch: Rice only brings misfortune to everyone... I really... really hope I can change that!
profile.detail: A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

profile.catch: Hello-lo. ♪ I'll dash toward my goal and be the first to cross the finish line!
profile.weight: Slight increase (maybe ate a little too much?)
profile.detail: An Umamusume with a friendly personality befitting an eldest daughter. She's known for her quick start and strong sense of responsibility. Despite working multiple part-time jobs to help support her two younger twin sisters, you will never find her complaining about it. Her mother granted her greatest wish by sending her to Tracen Academy, and she aims to repay that kindness in spades by showing excellent results.

profile.catch: Life is an experiment, and we its guinea pigs. You, me, the other Umamusume—everyone!
profile.detail: Equal parts researcher and runner, Agnes Tachyon pursues the limits of speed with the power of science. She will stop at nothing to quench her pure thirst for knowledge, performing all manner of experiments on living subjects—unauthorized, dangerous experiments, at that. Her extreme tunnel vision means that without someone to support her, day-to-day necessities quickly fall to the wayside.

profile.catch: I made a promise... to that shining star. That I would win, even if I have to do it alone.
profile.detail: A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers.

profile.catch: You heard right! Edo Umas don't let them legs rest until the day's well and spent!
profile.detail: An Umamusume with Edo pizzazz who grew up in an old-school Tokyo neighborhood, where the locals gave her toys, candy, and scoldings in equal measure. Despite being a bit of a troublemaker, she hates underhanded tricks beyond harmless fun. She may be small, but she runs in all the big races with style and grace—if she doesn't run out of steam and stumble out of the limelight. Her favorite food is inari sushi.

profile.catch: Uwaaagh! That was sooo touching!
profile.detail: Loud and proud, she's a straightforward soul who can get along well with anyone. She loves all sports, but holds special admiration for the Japanese Derby, a race that she dreams of winning one day, no matter the cost. She, Narita Taishin, and Biwa Hayahide are inseparable.

profile.catch: Speak logically. At its core, a race comes down to mathematical aggregation.
profile.detail: A rebel who only trusts the data she has collected. If she's winning a race, it's due entirely to her calculations and is never due to chance factors. No matter how many times she's calculated it, she comes up seven centimeters short of winning the Triple Crown, so she is currently searching for any possible error in her calculations to prove that it can be done.

profile.catch: Remain rigorous and exact in all that you do, and never stray from the recipe.
profile.weight: No change, not even by a gram!
profile.detail: A diligent and methodical exchange student from Germany. Everything she does is planned and scheduled down to the second. She likes to bake sweets as a hobby, and her precise nature may have arisen due to the unforgiving nature of measuring errors in baking. However, this same meticulousness makes her quick to panic when unexpected events or issues arise.

profile.catch: New day, same adorable Curren! ☆ Spread the word with #CurrenChan! ♪
profile.detail: When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series.

profile.catch: Unyielding, noble, and vigorous! That's what it means to be a princess!
profile.detail: A scrappy girl who aspires to ascend from the confines of ordinary life into royalty. She was always a bundle of energy growing up, but after watching a certain anime in which a princess fights hand-in-hand with a prince, she's been able to channel her zeal toward her future dreams—the least of which includes walking the path of a princess and finding her own prince one day. She admires King Halo as a mentor.

profile.catch: Right now, I'm just a pretty face... but not for long!
profile.detail: A beauty the likes of which will only appear once every one hundred years. She's been a model for as long as she can remember, and has always acted the part. She realized one day, however, that running is her true heart's desire. Since then, she has raced ever forward so that she may be recognized not for her looks, but for her talent. She's understood most by her good friend Tosen Jordan.

profile.catch: Bakushin on one! Bakushin on two! Bakushin, bakushiiin!
profile.detail: A class representative who'll rush recklessly into any situation. Once her mind is set on something, she'll bakushin dash straight to her goal—often causing more chaos than she helps resolve. She never acts out of self-righteousness, however, and tends to feel downhearted if no one is asking for her assistance. Her aptitude for sprinting is quite overwhelming, and she is confident that she can outrun anyone with unmatched speed.

profile.catch: The world is brimming with possibility! It's like an oyster that bore a pearl such as me!
profile.detail: An active older-sister type who insists on standing out and demonstrating that anything is possible on the world stage. Owing to the fact that she has lived in many countries growing up, she embodies confidence and has unique methods of self-expression. She is a talented soul who can accomplish all she sets out to do while eliciting laughter from those around her. She has a hopeless grasp of the English language, but she does a good job of compensating for it with her body language.

profile.catch: Grawr! Better not look away, or I’mma bite’cha!
profile.detail: A wild wolf who'll chomp ya good—or so she says. This Umamusume is a rascal who loves pranks, likely owing to the fact that she craves attention from others. Her vicious facade and munchy tendencies are clear pleas for affection, though she hasn't realized it herself. She also speaks with a similarly wild flare.

profile.catch: I can wield magic, you know! 'Cause I'm Magical Girl Sweepy!
profile.detail: A stubborn grandma's girl, she aspires to one day become a magical girl. Hoping to match her grandmother, a self-proclaimed witch, in magical prowess, she truly believes that if she keeps on winning races, her magic will also level up in turn. Since she's still learning magic, she often falls back on the good old-fashioned way of solving problems—with force. When she starts crying, it's hard to get her to stop.

profile.catch: I can spoil you as much as you'd like. Aww, there, there. ♪
profile.weight: Slight increase (a secret as to why)
profile.detail: No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

profile.catch: Hi, I'm Falco! My dream is to be the best Umadol I can be! ☆
profile.weight: Slight decrease (Umadol activities are rather taxing)
profile.detail: An Umamusume idol, or Umadol for short. She's always focused on looking cute while winning, and aims to be the center at every winning concert. She loves to interact with her fans and participates in any event that may serve as good publicity. Despite being a proficient dirt racer, she has a slight complex about being associated with the unsightly substance.

profile.catch: To be like the hero of a fantastical tale... I can't imagine any book lover not wishing the same.
profile.detail: A bibliophile who serves as a student library assistant at Tracen Academy. Though she comes off as quiet and reserved, within her burns the desire to embody the hero of an epic tale. She had always overcome most hurdles with ease, but rarely stood out. Ever since winning a certain freestyle race, however, the humble dream of becoming like the hero Rob Roy has welled up within her.

profile.catch: Always choose colors that'll look clean in pics, especially when we're talkin' about your nails! That's what style's all about! ☆
profile.detail: A trendy city girl who dislikes wasting effort for the sake of the status quo. She'll often attempt to escape difficult situations by claiming that she's too stupid to understand what's going on, but she is fully capable of applying herself when she wants to. She once fell into a serious slump because one of her nails broke, so she's been taking care to paint and maintain them ever since. As she has great communication skills, she has quite a lot of friends.

profile.catch: Winners see the gates of heaven, losers see the gates of hell. That's just life, eh?
profile.detail: A risk junkie and rule-breaker. She used to lack drive, but under the guidance of her elementary school mentor, she discovered the adrenaline-pumping thrill of racing. She can only live on the edge, and tends to cut corners in unremarkable, everyday situations. She's not pressed by newfangled fads, instead preferring to hang out in back alleys, sharing a pot of old-school offal stew with strangers.

profile.catch: I'll show them! I can win... I know it!
profile.detail: A rebellious soul who is sharp as a tack. She was often teased for her small stature, so now she runs to prove her true abilities. Her coarse nature is a by-product of her disdain of being looked down upon. She is good friends with schoolmates Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide.

profile.catch: All flowers want to be by someone's side. Even the smallest, quietest one of them all.
profile.detail: A softspoken, adorable, and innocent Umamusume. Though she's still a bit unsure of her future, she aims to bloom into an elegant lady. She's very thoughtful, and even if she's caught up with her own responsibilities, she's always considerate of those around her. The season of full bloom is surely just around the corner.

profile.catch: I won't let losing get me down! Urara, la la la! ♪
profile.detail: She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless positivity—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her.

profile.catch: Throw me the most extreme training you've got! I wanna beat any and all rivals!
profile.detail: A red-hot racer fueled by passion. She takes inspiration from her father's storied past, in which he was often locked in fierce competition with a rival. Her blood boils with a desire to one day have a rival to match. Inspired by a cool, bamboo sword–wielding disciplinary committee chair in a TV show she watched as a kid, she decided to take up the same mantle at Tracen Academy.

profile.catch: Traaansform! A hero can outrun anyone!
profile.detail: Biko Pegasus dreams of being just like Carrot Ranger from her favorite show! She was inspired by her amazing racing form after watching a certain episode, and now she even acts the part around the academy! She's going to be a while in that toy store...

profile.catch: The world is just oh-so marvelous! ☆ It falls to me to make it even more MAAAAARVELOUS!
profile.detail: Marvelous Sunday has always been gifted with an exuberant excess of energy, but didn't always have a purpose to channel that energy toward when she was a young child. Everything changed however, when she learned the word "marvelous" from her grandmother. From that day on, her eyes have seen the world in one color and one color only: marvelous! She now spends her days looking for marvelous, spreading marvelous, and simply being marvelous. ☆

profile.catch: Oho, what's this I see? Today's divination: great fortune! ☆
profile.weight: No change because today is my lucky day!
profile.detail: A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck. If she's not divining for her own sake, then she's divining for someone else's. She places an immense faith in a revelation from a certain god stating that as long as she keeps running, the way forward will open up before her. The name of the cat shaped bag that she carries is "Miss Nya."

profile.catch: Once the race begins, our world comes to life. Isn't that wonderful?
profile.detail: A living legend and lover of the sense of freedom races bring her. Her ability to march to the beat of her own drum with unwavering confidence attracts others to her. Yet behind that free-spirited nature hides a stubbornness that prevents her from doing anything she doesn't believe in—in which case, she may be more awkward than most.

profile.catch: Oh no... Someone like me shouldn't be racing... But still...
profile.detail: Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires T.M. Opera O's grandiose self-confidence.

profile.catch: You don't need to worry about little old me... Besides, I'm not used to getting so much attention...
profile.detail: While cool and reticent, she remains tense in many social situations, especially if men are present. Though she was raised in the prestigious Mejiro household, where visitors are never rare, she has nonetheless led a very sheltered life. Perhaps because of this, she can come off cold to strangers, but those who take the time to talk to her realize that she is not quite as uptight as she first seems.

profile.catch: Yup, I'm happy with a third place finish—it's all an extra like me can ask for.
profile.detail: An Umamusume of humble background with a penchant for being pessimistic. She tends to think of herself as a supporting character, and this causes her to shy away from high expectations—this sometimes leads to imperfect performances. She has quite the knack for cooking and cleaning due to her working-class upbringing, and does so whenever she has time. She's something of a familiar face among the seniors in her town.

profile.catch: I'll have everyone know that I'll be the first-rate of them all!
profile.detail: An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

profile.catch: Y'know, I kinda get the feeling I can really do it this time!
profile.weight: Slight increase (ate a bit too much)
profile.detail: Straightforward and positive-thinking, this model student always gives 110 percent! But despite her efforts, her inner ditz often has her fumbling in crucial moments. The ups and downs balance out into results that are—according to her—completely average. She sometimes wishes she could be more like the strong personalities around her, but she's determined to charge through and find success her own way!

profile.catch: Check, and then check again. That is how you minimize risk of injury.
profile.detail: A straight-laced Umamusume with the organizational prowess of a secretary. She expertly manages her condition with cool, collected assessments, but is surprisingly personable despite her strictness. She's fiercely determined to keep herself running for as long as possible—inspired by a time in the past when she could not...

profile.catch: You worried about somethin'? Well hey, I'm here if you need me.
profile.detail: A young lady from the renowned Mejiro family, though you might not guess it from her casual, friendly attitude. She's quite a socialite and notices even little changes in the people around her, but having such talented relatives caused her to develop a bit of an inferiority complex. Eventually, she found a way to handle those feelings—run, run, and run some more, smiling all the way. As long as she keeps running ahead, she'll one day forge her own destiny.

profile.catch: Wahey! Your vibes are off the charts! ☆ Let's party and have some fun! ♪
profile.detail: "I'm so loud?! Well, DUH, if you're gonna do something, you gotta make it FUN! And if you wanna call that cringe, I'll just crank it up even louder! ♪" That's the mindset of this bright, chatty runner. Get ready for smilemaxxing and par-tays, 'cause she's in it to enjoy it. Helios is never one to turn down an invitation, and has a way of making every occasion a blast.

profile.catch: Turbo's my name, and speed's my game! Let's race, right now! Hey! You listenin' to me?!
profile.detail: A student brimming with youthful energy who just wants to run, run, run like crazy! She doesn't really know her own limits yet, so she has a tendency to hit them full-force, but she seems to be enjoying life on the wild side. She's a bit immature compared to the other runners her age, and she can be a bit selfish, but it's hard to fault her honest, whimsical personality.

profile.catch: Everyone believes in my ability to win. I shall shine on like a brilliant diamond for them!
profile.weight: No ups or downs to worry about here.
profile.detail: Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

profile.catch: I'll give it a go! You'll never know unless you try, right?
profile.weight: In the middle of a growth spurt!
profile.detail: Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

profile.catch: Diligence is key—just like when in spring, cherry blossoms bloom... Ooh, that's a good one!
profile.detail: A pure-hearted, honest Umamusume. She admires Maruzensky, and aims to be her equal in every way. She makes a habit out of filling her "Chiyonotes" with proverbs relevant to her daily experiences—though few but her are able to parse them.

profile.catch: Cease your nagging! The top spot is mine for the taking.
profile.detail: "The brightest star out there is Sirius." With unmatched confidence and the prowess to back it up, she dreams of winning big on the world stage. Her rough mannerisms and crude way of speaking exude a toughness and charisma that attracts many to her. She despises lies and ambiguity, so everyone knows that she means exactly what she says. In other words, she's a natural-born star in every sense.

profile.catch: History may be recounted later as one likes, yet I choose to shine in the here and now.
profile.detail: A sheltered young lady—ephemeral, gentle, and thoughtful. Despite her fragile, "glass" legs putting her at a disadvantage when running, she refuses to let cynicism keep her down. As a child, her frail body kept her from most recreation and social activities, so she finds community life at the academy to be quite the novel experience.

profile.catch: Ensuring that the Kongo Yaegaki school thrives is the only way I can repay gram—ahem, my grandparents, for everything they've given me.
profile.detail: With fists that pierce the wind and kicks that shake the earth, this martial artist trains not to harm others but to succeed on the track. Though she strives to maintain discipline and decorum, her hotheaded side sometimes seeps to the surface. She loves her grandparents very much, and seeks to do them proud by spreading their school of martial arts far and wide.

profile.catch: Gotta give every race my all. Go, me, g—cough, hack, wheeze
profile.detail: Pushing her limits further each day despite her delicate constitution, she wants nothing more than to achieve a Triple Crown legacy. She approaches life with a positive and energetic attitude, and those around her can tell that she puts her heart and soul into everything she does. Though her body tragically won't let her show her full potential, she gets back up after every fall to run toward her dream at full speed.

profile.catch: Oh, is it time for my race already? Well then, I suppose I shall get ready.
profile.weight: Slight increase (Oh dear... Seems I ate just a teeny bit too much)
profile.detail: A laid-back and easygoing lady of the Mejiro family. Her clumsy side means she does not shoulder the same level of expectation as other members of the estate, but some believe that within the right set of circumstances, she could prove to be one of the family's most influential figures.

profile.catch: No matter how bitingly cold winter is, the day will come when the cherry blossoms bloom. You can count on it!
profile.detail: A fearless optimist whose positive outlook is all the more striking given the fragile legs she was born with. No matter how many times injuries knock her down, she gets right back up, perhaps driven by her goal of one day defeating Narita Brian, whom she shares a special rivalry with.

profile.catch: I'll face these challenges however many times it takes. I'll surely live up to your expectations!
profile.detail: A spirited competitor practically overflowing with positive energy. She wants nothing more than to meet the expectations of her fans and is determined to surmount any challenge to do so. Her willingness to acknowledge and compliment her competitors' strengths has earned her the popularity and respect of her peers. Though she has the makings of a star, she often seems to find herself in more of a supporting role.

profile.catch: My soul burns like an inferno in my chest... I'll run with the speed of a howling gale.
profile.detail: A breezy Umamusume grounded in nature with a particular fondness for the wind. When she enters a race, however, she overwhelms the competition with her tempestuous speed. As a child, she grew to admire a certain mile racer who blew past her rivals with overwhelming strength. Ever since, she has pledged to become as the wind, just like her idol.

profile.catch: Victory is my mission. I will see it through.
profile.detail: A stoic foreign exchange student of few words who values efficiency and win probability above all when it comes to racing. She's firmly mission-oriented, and her focused demeanor often frightens others, but her obsession with results comes from a sense of duty to those who have helped her. In other words, she possesses a noble spirit.

profile.catch: Witness me! Let my intoxicating charm ensnare you! Now behold, as I smash it all to dust!
profile.detail: This racer possesses an aesthetic all her own and treats it as a code to live by. Her speed grants her dominion over the mile, while her strength makes her a master of the medium-distance races—making her an overwhelming talent. Vodka looks up to her with eyes sparkling. She's earned herself a bit of a reputation as a veritable "God of Destruction" who breaks down the very fences that would box her in.

profile.catch: Stand ever glorious, ever supreme—and always shine the brightest. That is the maxim of our house.
profile.detail: A refined Umamusume born into the family of magnificence, known far and wide for their opulent lineage. In accordance to her family's image, she strives to maintain noble mannerisms and tends to utilize a certain diction that keeps most at bay.

profile.catch: I'm Aston Machan. As-ton Ma-chan. Don't go forgetting now, okay?
profile.detail: Mysterious and spacey, this racer's eccentricities know no bounds. She records voice memos in her free time, and she always makes sure to bring a Machan doll wherever she goes—just in case the cameras start rolling around this soon-to-be world-famous mascot. Still, could there be a deeper reason behind her mysterious ways?

profile.catch: Someday, I'll bring about a miracle. So watch over me, okay?
profile.detail: Kind and gentle of heart, this Umamusume possesses a personality most calm. She has miraculously come back from the brink of death twice in her life, and feels indebted to those who helped her fight on. For that reason, she now runs to repay their kindness, and she's willing to put everything on the line to do so.

profile.catch: Rickey ☆ Lucky ☆ Everyone's happy! Leave the racing and bestowing of good fortune to me!
profile.detail: A bright and cheerful Umamusume known for her amazing luck. Her knowledge of feng shui is second to none, and she uses it to navigate not only her daily life, but also her approach to training and races. She insists on making those around her happy with the power of feng shui, and her advice for attaining good fortune is highly sought after.

profile.catch:
Tomakomai City Tourism Ambassador, Hokko Tarumae, ready t'shine! ☆
Hmm... Would it come off cuter if I glanced up like this?
profile.detail: A local idol hailing from Tomakomai whose love of her hometown earned her an official appointment as a tourism ambassador. She hopes to attract attention to Tomakomai through her races and concerts, so she devotes her days to finding ways to improve her skills and appeal. However, that same zeal is also her greatest weakness, as she has a tendency to overly fixate on details.

profile.catch: That's right, dearie... The key is to never give up.
profile.detail: A  gentle Umamusume whose sweet attentiveness puts others at ease. Many even find themselves warmly recalling their grandmothers when speaking with her. As a race approaches, however, you can feel a stoic discipline well up from within as she faces the track with a steely resolve.

profile.catch: I’ll run a ton... and win. Yay.
profile.detail: Scatterbrained and absent-minded, she doesn't talk much and spaces out time and time again. It's hard to tell what she's thinking most of the time—probably because she isn't thinking of anything at all. Under the guidance of her trainer, Aoi Kiryuin, she strives to make a name for herself in the Twinkle Series.

profile.catch: Guts! Glory! And gumptiooon!
profile.detail: This Umamusume lives to compete. She boasts tremendous strength and a permanent excess of energy, but her fanatic love of training puts distance between herself and others. Though ill-suited to teamwork, she doesn't let that or anything else get in the way of becoming stronger. Her favorite pastime is seeing how long she can stand the heat of a sauna.

profile.catch: Heh... If you think you can beat us by playing buddy-buddy, then just go ahead and try.
profile.detail: A stoic Umamusume with a sharp tongue and a standoffish attitude. She detests having to change anything about herself, and is, thus, reluctant to join group activities. Combined with her harsh language, that may make her seem cynical, but in fact, she has a compassionate side as well. More than most though, she holds a greedy hunger to become stronger. She also has a passion for fashion.

profile.catch: Trainer, welcome to Tracen Academy! ♪ I'm looking forward to seeing how you and your Umamusume grow!
profile.detail: As secretary to the director of Tracen Academy, Tazuna aims to be a pillar of support not only for students, but also for trainers. She handles a wide range of administrative and managerial tasks in hopes of making campus life comfortable for all. That said, if you break curfew, you'd better hope you can outrun her.

profile.catch: Greetings! I hereby welcome you to Tracen Academy! Now, go forth, and make your Umamusume's dreams come true!
profile.detail: Behold! Akikawa is the director of Tracen Academy. Behind her exuberant tone and behavior lies a strong will to support all Umamusume. Her generous out-of-pocket support has earned her the respect and gratitude of the students, as well as some stern talking-tos from her secretary Tazuna.

profile.catch: Thank you for agreeing to today's interview. I've been looking forward to speaking with you.
profile.detail: A reporter for the monthly "Twinkle" magazine. She pours her heart and soul into her reporting for the betterment of the racing world. She has just about as much knowledge as trainers do. When she gets too enthusiastic in her reports, she sometimes exaggerates things, but... it just goes to show how sky-high her hopes are.

profile.catch: You're an amazing trainer... But as your colleague and rival, I can't back down now!
profile.detail: The sole daughter of the Kiryuin family, a prestigious family of trainers. Using the Trainer's Handbook, a collection of Kiryuin techniques, she works hard every day to help her trainee Happy Meek win. Her dedication to everything she does has earned high expectations from those around her.

profile.catch: I've got this! There's probably a pressure point around... here! See? No worries! ☆ ...Right? Right?!
profile.detail: While it's unclear who would bestow such a title, she's (allegedly) a budding legend in the acupuncture sphere. She (claims to be) the sole apprentice of a master acupuncturist, and has learned the godly techniques for herself. It's said that any concern could hypothetically be cured by her pinpoint-precise needlework. She even claims she can also imbue patients with power untold. Should you chose to believe her, ultimately, is up to you.

profile.catch: It is our duty as trainers to ensure an Umamusume's peak condition. Our management and record keeping must be flawless.
profile.detail: A veteran trainer from the URA, she came to assist Tracen Academy with a quiet zeal in her heart. Her direct and inflexible attitude may make her seem cold-hearted at first glance, but her passion for the well-being of Umamusume is second to none. While she excels thoroughly at her job, it would appear that physical activity isn't her strong suit...

profile.catch: We're going to make the Grand Concert an absolute success, and we're going to do it together!
profile.detail: The producer behind the "Grand Concert Reboot Project." Her passion for the prestigious event is unparalleled, making her the perfect candidate for managing its revitalization. Rumor has it she was once a Tracen Academy student herself, and may even have some racing experience of her own...
